items.name: P3 Grand Open 2016
items.information:
If the number of participants are more than 150 in any event, we may restrict the further participants. Partipants needs to pre-register in WCA and they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 3rd or 4th December 2016 to participate. Participation registration closes on 1st December 2016 at 9:00pm IST. Payment should be made before 1st December 2016 at 9:00pm IST to get the registration confirmation. Participation will be cancelled if there is a failure of registration and payment before the given cut off time. 

All the participants are recommended to be available 30 minutes before the event of participation in the venue. Non-Indian nationality participants are requested to bring their passport.

items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2016

venue.name: QBE Stadium
venue.address: North Harbour Stadium, Albany, Auckland 0632, New Zealand

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2016 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: SPB Winter 2016
items.information: Registration will be closed on November, 27 or when we reach 80 competitors. Registration fee is 250 RUB for any 3 events. Each next event is +10 RUB. Please see the website for more information.

items.name: ODU Big Blue Winter 2016

venue.name: Webb University Center, Old Dominion University

items.information: Registration is $20 and proceeds will be donated to the ODU Engineers Without Borders club. The competitor limit is 100 people with no at-the-door registration. Until you pay the registration fee, you will be placed on a waiting list. With the WCA system, registration must be manually checked before approval, so please allow up to 24 hours to be moved from the waiting list.
